construction: Use the unchanged original categorical pair data and full original vocabulary. Do not invoke the earlier bijective output-code discovery. Prefer the new candidate if it is first within 1e-8 of the common full-vocabulary training-CE lower bound; otherwise use the minimum training CE in [new, previous selected] order. Retain the previous selection and both candidates with all costs even if accuracy regresses. No held-out metric chooses a candidate. provenance: Require the complete 16-cell phase cohort with 24 choices, including its unchanged complete cold/graph parents, before preparation. Save parent summary and digest. resource_policy: Construction and replay are strictly serial under an 8 GiB address-space cap with single-thread BLAS. Validate dimensions and observation counts before numerical buffers, keep the conservative 2 GiB buffer forecast and 16 GiB disk reserve. Stream JSON writes and bound JSON reads. Never overwrite an existing cohort, silently resume an interrupted cell, or drop an unsuccessful planned cell. Wait for the preceding queued phase cohort to finish successfully. Preserve generated evidence in ignored root runs.
